# <span id="aanchor442"></span> Change Password

All users can change their own passwords (this does not apply to FLOWCAL Instant Login users). You will need to log in with your existing password to update this information.

Passwords must conform to the requirements established for your Oracle profile by your database administrator.

<div class="procedure">

To change your password: 

1.  Go to **Settings**, and select **Change Password**.

2.  Enter your old password. Passwords must contain a minimum of three characters.

3.  Enter your new password.

4.  Enter the password again to confirm the change.

5.  Click **OK**.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 260;height: 227;" />

    If desired, you can set an expiration time limit for the password, configurable from the [User Access](../Settings%20Manager/Security/User%20Access.md) screen.

</div>

If you have forgotten your password or did not change it before the expiration date, an administrator can log in and change the password by going to the User Access screen and clicking the "Edit Password" option.
